name: Aira
appearance: A young Indian woman in her mid-twenties with long dark brown hair, loosely waved and falling past her shoulders, parted slightly off-centre. Warm medium skin tone, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, full defined eyebrows, high cheekbones, a softly rounded jaw and a natural warm smile. Slim build, average height.
voice: Warm, bright young female voice with a natural Indian English accent, medium pitch, clear unforced pronunciation, conversational rather than presentational.
speakingStyle:
Speaks natural Hinglish, switching easily between Hindi and English. Sounds like a friend talking to camera, not a voice-over. Lively pitch variation, genuine enthusiasm, natural pauses. Never flat, never salesy.
She should always be speaking in hinglish that is mix of english and hindi
